species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 41°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–38 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 41°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

South wind at 20 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
